title: introduction-to-hood2net
text: CONSTRUCTION hood2net package takes list words /phonological transcriptions creates language network based neighborhood structure. First, phonological/orthographic neighbors item list identified based various definitions “neighbor”. pair words can considered neighbors (thus become connected network) via following ways: edit-distance (substitution, deletion, addition; .e., Levenshtein) substitution (.e., Hamming). default setting uses distance 1, larger distances can specified liberal definition neighbor. segmentation transcription can also specified: either based single character (.e., single letter phoneme) user-specified segments indicated separators (e.g., larger chunks like syllables morphemes single character separated ‘.’). hood2net summarizes neighborhood information items list igraph network object subsequent analyses. Helper functions extracting network metrics, neighborhood size, information language network provided. package intended psycholinguists interested modeling language networks lexical neighborhoods various languages.
